correctness.rationale: Every nonzero Artin–Schreier character has a single odd-degree-five pole at infinity, giving a connected degree-four Galois cover and g=6 from Riemann–Hurwitz. Odd-power reduced characters are unique over algebraically closed char2. In the actual RESULT.md formula (1), affine x↦ax+b changes the x^5 coefficient by a^5 and x^3 trace coefficient by a^3; equality of subspaces for λ,μ≠0 forces a^5=1 and μ=λa^3, equivalent to λ^5=μ^5. The linear coefficient yields b^16=b and, for λ≠0, b=0 or b^3=λ^{-1}. There are respectively 16×15, four, and one admissible base affine maps, each with exactly four deck lifts. These equations cover zero, symmetry jump, and generic boundaries. The supplied F256 script independently expands and reduces characteristic-two polynomials; its finite sample is corroboration, not the all-k proof.
